summary: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, announcing the appointment of Dr. Chen Lichtenstein as President and CEO, effective July 1, 2026, succeeding Eli Glickman who resigned on April 15, 2026. Dr. Lichtenstein will also join the Board. His employment agreement requires shareholder approval under Israeli law. The prior CEO's resignation in April and the subsequent appointment of an external candidate constitute a forced/abrupt management change. No deal terms are stated. What to watch: shareholder vote on the employment agreement and any strategic shifts under new leadership.
